title: AI access
lede: Assistants such as ChatGPT or Claude that you connected to Recreatio (MCP) read the areas of their connection — only read, and only the Library, Scriptorium and knowledge bases. Add, renew or remove areas here.
manageHint: Already connected an assistant? Add this area to its connection without signing in again:
connectLater: You can add more areas to this connection later, without connecting again:
unlockWhy: Access links open only on your device — enter your password.
none: No assistant is connected yet. In ChatGPT or Claude, add a custom MCP server with the address above and OAuth; Recreatio then asks you which areas it may read. After that, its connection appears here and you can add more areas.
older: Connections made before 5 November 2026 keep working with the areas chosen back then, but they are not listed here and cannot be extended. Reconnect such an assistant once; from then on you add areas here.

how.title: How it works
how.noReconnect: Adding, renewing or removing an area needs no new sign-in: the assistant sees the change at its next call (list_collections).
how.reconnect: Sign in again from the assistant only for a new assistant, an older connection, or a connection that was revoked or has expired.
how.readOnly: Always read-only: the assistant can search and read the collections of its areas. It cannot change anything and never sees learner progress, answers, chats, forms or calendars.

connection.noAreas: This connection reads no area right now. Add one — the assistant stays connected.

statusHelp.expired: The access link of this area has expired. Renew it, and the assistant reads it again.
statusHelp.pending: The access link of this area was never finished. Remove the area and add it again.
statusHelp.notLeader: You no longer lead this area, so this connection does not read it.
statusHelp.creatorLeft: The person who made this access link no longer leads the area. Remove the area and add it again — a new link is made.

area.whole: Whole area — collections created later are included.

remove.body: The assistant stops reading this area at its next call. Other areas stay connected, and the area's access link itself is kept.

revoke.body: The assistant loses access to every area of this connection at its next call. The areas' access links are kept. To connect it again, sign in from the assistant.

add.title: Add an area to {client}

subtree.one: Also the {count} area below it that you lead
subtree.other: Also the {count} areas below it that you lead

add.newLink: A new read-only access link for the whole area is made, valid for {days}.
add.existing: Uses the area's access link, valid until {date}.
add.existingWhole: Uses the area's access link for the whole area, valid until {date}.
add.permissionsText: read only. The assistant can search and read these collections and their full texts. It cannot change anything and sees no learner progress, answers, chats, forms or calendars.
add.noReconnect: No new sign-in is needed: the areas appear for the assistant at its next call, next to the areas it already reads.
add.noKey: {area}: its access link cannot be opened on this device (the area's key is missing).
add.nothing: You lead no area with a Library, Scriptorium or knowledge base.

error.link_not_allowed: This area's access link does not work, or you do not lead the area.
error.too_many: This connection already reads the most areas it can (20). Remove one first.
error.not_ready: The service is not updated yet — try again later.
